item.title: 6 women killed in California avalanche were among 8 close friends and experienced skiers on trip
item.description: SODA SPRINGS, Calif. (AP) — Six women killed in the deadliest avalanche in the U.S. in decades were part of a close-knit group of friends who were experienced backcountry skiers and knew how to navigate the wilderness of California's Sierra Nevada, their families said Thursday. Two of the friends got out alive and were rescued [...]

item.title: Washburn woman's murder conviction upheld; resentencing set
item.description: Maya Nodine's murder conviction was upheld by an appellate court panel, but she was granted a new sentencing hearing due to unclear factors used in the original sentencing.

item.title: East Peoria police arrest two people on child pornography charges
item.description: Gage W. L. Fandel, 20, and Kristina M. Modglin, 28, have been arrested and charged with possession and distribution of child pornography in East Peoria, Illinois.

item.title: U.S. Senate Democratic candidates to face off in statewide debate
item.description: WGN News will host a debate on February 19 between the leading candidates for the Democratic Party nomination for U.S. Senator from Illinois, moderated by WGN News political editor Tahman Bradley and anchor/reporter Micah Materre.

item.title: 'Fortuitous not to be facing murder' prosecutors says of two charged in crime spree
item.description: Two 18-year-olds were held pending the outcome of allegations that they participated in a crime spree in Peoria, Illinois that involved a car chase and an attack on a 15-year-old boy.

item.title: East Peoria bar owner reacts to possible Chicago Bears move to Indiana
item.description: The Chicago Bears are exploring a potential stadium site in Hammond, Indiana, sparking conversation among fans in Central Illinois who believe the team will remain loyal to them regardless of where they play.

item.title: OSF Cancer Institute expanding to build Peoria into regional destination for cancer care
item.description: The OSF HealthCare Cancer Institute in Peoria is expanding with an additional 29,000 square feet of space to bring together specialists and provide coordinated care for patients across central Illinois.

item.title: Peoria County State's Attorney says juvenile justice system is 'going the wrong way'
item.description: Peoria County's top prosecutor, Jodi Hoos, is calling for reform of the state's Juvenile Court Act to give judges more discretion on how long juveniles are kept in prison after being sentenced, as violent offenders are getting younger and the law does not have a good way to deal with them.

item.title: Unit 5 unveils two plans for new school district boundaries
item.description: Unit 5 presented two proposals for new school district boundaries at a public meeting, with both proposals sharing some common ground, such providing enrollment relief to certain schools, but Proposal Two was more popular with the community.

item.title: Severe storms hit Central Illinois, large hail reported
item.description: Peoria, ILL (WMBD) -- A strong storm system brought scattered severe storms to central Illinois on Thursday bringing large hail to a few communities.
